item.title: New Car Sales Remained Flat In 2025, But Electrified Vehicles Really Took Off
item.description: New car sales ended flat in 2025 with 463,646 units sold based on the full year data released by members of the Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines (CAMPI) and Truck Manufacturers Association (TMA). 2025’s full-year figure is 0.8 percent lower than 2024’s 467,252.Read More »

item.title: As The Philippine Launch Of The Haval H9 Nears, GWM Philippines Took Us Through An Experiential Deep Dive
item.description: As GWM Philippines gears up for the launch of their much-awaited Haval H9, we took a first-hand look at the engineering, technology, and capability behind this 7-seater mid-size SUV in China.Read More »

item.title: VinFast Accelerates Xentro Motors' Taxi Fleet With More Than 500 Units Of VF e34 BEVs
item.description: VinFast continues to strengthen its presence in the Philippine market after turning over 500 electric vehicles to accelerate Xentro Motors’ deployment of EV-powered ride-hailing fleet.Read More »

item.title: Jeep PH Slashing Prices Up To P 2-Million Until End January
item.description: Inchcape Philippines, distributor of Chrysler, Dodge, Jeep, and Ram Trucks in the Philippines, under its IC Automotive Inc. operations, is slashing prices up to P 2 million. This makes driving home the most iconic American 4x4s more attainable than ever.Read More »

item.title: Toyota PH Celebrates Sinulog With Coco Martin
item.description: Toyota Motor Philippines (TMP) brought extra excitement to this year’s Sinulog celebration by welcoming Coco Martin to Cebu City during the festival weekend. Through this, TMP highlighted its support for local traditions and its commitment to engaging communities across the Philippines.Read More »

item.title: RADAR EV Pickup Trucks Now Serving The Bataan Community
item.description: The Provincial Government of Bataan marked another milestone in its push toward sustainable, future-ready governance with the official turnover of seven Radar RD6 Econ 73-kWh 4WD full electric pickup trucks. The turnover ceremony was held at the 1Bataan Command Center, attended by the key provincial and municipal officials, and the Radar EV Pickup Team from UAAGI Auto Group.Read More »

item.title: Ford Reinforces Safety With Inspection, Repair Of Defective Airbags
item.description: In line with its commitment to the safety of its customers, Ford Philippines is re-issuing a service program urging owners whose vehicles are affected by defective Takata airbags to visit a Ford dealership as soon as possible.Read More »

item.title: It's Official: GAC International Philippines Unifies GAC Motor, Aion, Hyptec Brands
item.description: The GAC Group has made official the establishment of a directly run subsidiary, GAC International Philippines, Inc., that consolidates all GAC brands under one umbrella. It’s a reflection of the Chinese brand’s long-term commitment in investing in products, distribution networks, customer service, and operational capabilities in the country.Read More »

item.title: Volvo Cars PH Offering P 500K Discount On Its PHEVs
item.description: Hariphil Asia Resources, Inc. (HARI), the official distributor of Volvo Cars Philippines, has a limited time offer on its premium plug-in electric vehicle (PHEV) line-up headed by the XC90 PHEV T8 and the XC60 PHEV T8.Read More »

item.title: Changan Opens In Bacoor And Angeles
